note: `title` set to `{}` instead of a quote object or the absent marker. `title` is `quoteOrAbsent`, a oneOf between `$defs.quote` (needs text+span) and `$defs.absent` (the literal "not in source") — an empty object matches neither branch, so this is a oneOf failure with zero branches matched, not a value that happens to look empty-but-harmless.
